title: 相亲相爱一家人
setting: Saturday, 7:02 am. The family group chat is up before you are.

giveup.narr: Mum removed you from the group chat.

giveup.en: Removed from the family group by your own mum. Your cousin gets your dumplings.

steps.narr: Saturday, 7:02 am. Your phone lights up: the family group chat has exploded again.

steps.en: Good morning! Be happy every day!

steps.zh: 震惊！隔夜水千万别喝，很多人还不知道！
steps.en: SHOCKING! Never drink water that's stood overnight. So many people still don't know!
You know about these things. Is it true?

say.en: Tell your aunt, nicely, that it's a rumour: don't believe it.
answers: 三姨，这是谣言，别信哈。
三姨，这个是假的，别信。
这是谣言，别转了！
假的假的，别信！
say.gloss: Auntie, that's a rumour. Don't believe it.
say.tip: 谣言 yáoyán = rumour, fake news. 别信 = don't believe it. A 哈 on the end keeps it friendly to an elder.

ok.en: How could it be a rumour?

ok.zh: 你们年轻人就是不信，等出了事就晚了。
ok.en: You young people never believe anything. By the time something happens, it'll be too late.

answers: 这是假的，别信哈！
三姨，这是假的！
假的，别信！
这是谣言，别信！
2.tip: 假的 jiǎ de = fake, not true. 别信 = don't believe it; the 哈 keeps it friendly.

4.en: Tell your aunt, nicely, that it's a rumour: it was debunked long ago.
answers: 三姨，这是谣言，早就辟谣了！
三姨，这是假的，早就辟谣了。
这是谣言，官方早辟谣了，别信哈！
假的假的，人家早就辟谣了！
4.gloss: Auntie, it's a rumour. It was debunked ages ago!
4.tip: 辟谣 pìyáo = debunk a rumour (官方辟谣 = officially debunked). 早就……了 = … long ago.

steps.zh: 好了好了，大清早的别吵了
steps.en: All right, all right, no arguing this early in the morning.

steps.zh: 妈刚发了个朋友圈，快去点赞！
steps.en: I just posted on Moments. Go and like it!

steps.zh: 妈妈举着广场舞比赛的奖杯
steps.en: Mum holding up a trophy from a square-dancing contest.

say.en: Tell Mum you've liked it, and that the photo looks great.
answers: 点了点了！拍得真好看！
已经点赞了！妈你真棒！
赞了！拍得太好看了！
点赞了，妈妈真厉害！
say.gloss: Done, done! The photo looks great!
say.tip: 点赞 = like a post. 点了点了 = done, done! 拍得真好看: verb + 得 + how it came out (the photo turned out great).

fail.en: Can't even give your own mum a like.

answers: 点赞了！照片真好看！
点了点了！真好看！
赞了！妈妈真棒！
已经点赞了！真漂亮！
2.gloss: Liked it! The photo looks great!
2.tip: 点赞 diǎn zàn = like a post. 照片真好看 = the photo looks really good.

4.en: Tell Mum you've liked it and the photo looks great. Then: that's my mum, a true champion!
answers: 点了点了！拍得真好看，不愧是我妈！
赞了！妈你太厉害了，不愧是冠军！
点赞了！真漂亮，不愧是我妈！
点了点了！太棒了，不愧是我妈！
4.gloss: Done, done! The photo looks great. That's my mum!
4.tip: 不愧是…… = every inch a …, as you'd expect of …: 不愧是我妈 = that's my mum! 拍得真好看 = the photo came out great.

steps.en: Say something nice, then you can open it!

steps.zh: 谁说得好听，红包就是谁的！
steps.en: Whoever says the nicest thing gets the red packet!

say.en: Beat your cousin: thank your uncle by his title, and wish him good health.
answers: 谢谢大舅！祝您身体健康！
谢谢大舅，祝您万事如意！
祝大舅身体健康，越活越年轻！
谢谢大舅！祝大舅财源滚滚！
say.gloss: Thank you, Uncle! Wishing you good health!
say.tip: Title first (大舅 = Mum's eldest brother), then a wish: 祝您身体健康 = wishing you good health. 您 is the respectful 你.

mistakes.note: 叔叔 is Dad's side, or any grown man. Mum's brother is 舅舅, and the eldest is 大舅.

ok.en: Ha! It's the thought that counts!

4.en: Out-bless your cousin: wish your uncle, by his title, good health and every success.
answers: 祝大舅身体健康，万事如意！
谢谢大舅！祝您身体健康，万事如意！
祝大舅身体健康，心想事成！
谢谢大舅，祝您财源滚滚，万事如意！
4.gloss: Wishing you good health, Uncle, and may everything go your way!
4.tip: 万事如意 = may everything go as you wish; 心想事成 = may your wishes come true. Strung after 身体健康, they make the full 吉祥话.

steps.zh: 小宝啊，过年回不回来呀？外婆给你包饺子。
steps.en: Xiao Bao, are you coming home for New Year? Grandma will make you dumplings.

steps.zh: 外婆看不清字，你给她发语音
steps.en: Grandma can't read the screen. Send her a voice message.

say.en: Hold to talk: tell Grandma yes, you're coming home, and you miss her.
answers: 回来！外婆，我好想你！
外婆，我回来！我想你了！
一定回来！外婆，我好想您！
回！外婆我想死你了！
say.gloss: I'm coming! Grandma, I miss you so much!
say.tip: 我好想你 = I miss you so much (好 = so). 想死你了, 'missing you to death', is warmer still.

ok.zh: 好好好！外婆给你包三百个饺子！
ok.en: Good, good, good! Grandma will make you three hundred dumplings!
Look how happy you've made Grandma.

fail.en: Xiao Bao? Grandma can't hear you.

4.en: Hold to talk: tell Grandma you're definitely coming home, and you miss her even in your dreams.
answers: 一定回！外婆，我做梦都想您！
肯定回来！外婆，我做梦都想您！
回！外婆，我做梦都想吃您包的饺子！
一定回去！外婆，我梦里都想您！
4.gloss: Definitely! Grandma, I miss you even in my dreams!
4.tip: 做梦都想…… = miss (or want) … even in your dreams. 一定 = definitely.

steps.en: Hello? Hello? How do I turn this off?
Grandma's last voice message runs the full sixty seconds: the telly, the dog, and 'how do I turn this off?' The whole group loses it.
steps.zh: 外婆的语音又是六十秒。
